description: Algorithm presets for Anomaly Detection GUI - Simple Mode Defaults

simple_mode.description: Recommended preset parameters for consistent, reliable anomaly detection

rolling_stats.name: Rolling Statistics Z-Score
rolling_stats.description: Detects extreme deviations from rolling mean using Z-score
rolling_stats.notes: Percentile method more robust. Low percentile (90) = more sensitive, High (99) = fewer alarms.

prediction_error.name: Prediction Error Anomaly
prediction_error.description: Detects forecast errors above moving average baseline
prediction_error.notes: Percentile method recommended. Works with trending data and captures sudden changes.

hybrid.name: Hybrid Score (RECOMMENDED)
hybrid.description: Weighted combination of Z-score, trend, and volatility detection
hybrid.notes: RECOMMENDED for thesis. Percentile thresholds are robust and adaptive to data distribution.

isolation_forest.name: Isolation Forest (ML)
isolation_forest.description: Machine learning algorithm that isolates anomalies via random partitioning of temporal features
isolation_forest.notes: Detects contextual anomalies. Contamination = expected fraction of anomalies (0.01 = 1%). Uses rolling features for temporal context.

mean_shift.name: Mean Shift Detector
mean_shift.description: Detects abrupt level changes by comparing the means of two adjacent sliding windows
mean_shift.notes: Best for step changes and regime shifts. Window = half-width of comparison zone. Larger window = more stable but less reactive to short transitions.

key_datasets.description: 5 recommended NAB datasets for thesis evaluation - selected based on benchmark F1 scores across all 4 algorithms

datasets.name: EC2 CPU Utilization
datasets.description: EC2 instance CPU spikes - Hybrid F1=1.00, Isolation Forest F1=1.00
datasets.notes: Best overall dataset. Both Hybrid and Isolation Forest achieve perfect F1=1.00. Ideal for thesis demo.

datasets.name: RDS CPU Utilization
datasets.description: CPU spikes in AWS RDS database - Hybrid F1=0.80, Isolation Forest F1=0.50
datasets.notes: Strong dataset showing clear algorithm differentiation: Hybrid > IF > Rolling.

datasets.name: Artificial Spike Density
datasets.description: Synthetic increasing spike pattern - Hybrid F1=1.00, Rolling F1=0.06
datasets.notes: Perfect Hybrid score (1.00). Demonstrates why multi-signal approach outperforms simple Z-Score.

datasets.name: Travel Time 387
datasets.description: Real traffic travel time data - Hybrid F1=0.50, Rolling F1=0.43
datasets.notes: Real-world traffic dataset. All algorithms achieve reasonable F1. Good for demonstrating generalization.

datasets.name: Speed Sensor 6005
datasets.description: Real traffic speed data - Hybrid F1=0.40, Isolation Forest F1=0.40
datasets.notes: Hybrid and Isolation Forest tie (F1=0.40), both outperform Rolling. Interesting ML vs statistical comparison.

datasets.name: Load Balancer Spikes
datasets.description: Burst de spike-uri extreme intr-o fereastra de ~33 ore — exemplu clar de anomalie tip varf
datasets.notes: NECESITA sensitivity=High (percentile=92, contamination=0.10). Fereastra de anomalie contine ~10% din date.

datasets.name: Demo Mean Shift (Schimbare de Nivel)
datasets.description: 5 segmente cu medii diferite (10→35→60→38→15) si zgomot gaussian — demonstreaza detectia schimbarilor de nivel
datasets.notes: F1=0.89, FP=0 cu Mean Shift window=30, k=3. Dataset ideal pentru demonstrarea algoritmului Mean Shift.

datasets.name: Demo Spike-uri Izolate
datasets.description: 5 spike-uri izolate pe un baseline plat — dataset ideal pentru demonstrarea detectiei in Modul Simplu
datasets.notes: Toti algoritmii F1=1.00 cu sensitivitate Medium (k=3, IF cont=0.005). Dataset perfect pentru teza.

datasets.name: Demo Hybrid (Toate Tipurile de Anomalii)
datasets.description: Dataset sintetic cu 5 tipuri distincte: spike, burst de volatilitate, schimbare de nivel, schimbare de trend si flatline — demonstreaza toate canalele Hybrid
datasets.notes: Dataset de demonstratie pentru teza: 1500 puncte, 5 anomalii de tipuri diferite (spike, volatilitate, mean shift, trend, flatline). Ideal pentru a prezenta avantajele algoritmului Hybrid.

datasets.name: Consum Electric (Custom)
datasets.description: Date sintetice de consum electric cu 4 grupuri de anomalii clare — spike-uri, flatline si burst crescator
datasets.notes: Dataset custom: 1000 puncte, 5-min interval, 13 anomalii (1.3%). Hybrid F1=1.00, Rolling F1=0.93, IF F1=0.79, PredErr F1=0.73.

features: Dataset selection from 3 key NAB datasets

advanced_mode.description: Modify algorithm parameters for custom experimentation

ec2_cpu_utilization_825cc2.notes: Perfect detection. Best dataset for thesis demo.

rds_cpu_utilization_cc0c53.notes: Strong Hybrid result. Shows clear algorithm ranking.

art_increase_spike_density.notes: Perfect Hybrid. Shows multi-signal advantage over single Z-Score.

TravelTime_387.notes: Real traffic data. All algorithms reasonable.

speed_6005.notes: Hybrid ties Isolation Forest. Rolling significantly worse.

test_consum_electric.optimal_params_used: Hybrid pct=97; Rolling ws=50 pct=98.5; IF cont=0.02; PredErr fw=30 pct=98
test_consum_electric.notes: Custom dataset. Hybrid perfect (F1=1.00). Rolling excellent (F1=0.93). All 4 algos work well.

Low.description: Prag strict: 4σ deasupra mediei. Putine alarme false, dar poate rata spike-uri mici.

Medium.description: Prag 3σ (regula three-sigma). Echilibrat, recomandat pentru demonstratii.

High.description: Prag 2σ. Detectie agresiva, mai multe alarme false — pentru date cu anomalii frecvente.

thesis_recommendations.gui_strategy: Use Simple Mode as default (covers 80% of use cases). Advanced Mode for demonstrations.
thesis_recommendations.dataset_strategy: Test on 5 key datasets (not all 58). Selected by F1 score across all 4 algorithms.
thesis_recommendations.parameter_strategy: Presets locked in Simple Mode. Advanced Mode for expert tuning only.
thesis_recommendations.defense_demo: Run Hybrid on EC2 CPU (F1=1.00) and RDS CPU (F1=0.80). Compare with Isolation Forest.
thesis_recommendations.algorithm_narrative: Statistical methods (Rolling, Hybrid) vs ML (Isolation Forest). Hybrid best overall. IF useful for contextual anomalies.
